definitions.explanation: The line of latitude at about 66°33′ north that marks the southern edge of the Arctic. North of it, the sun stays above the horizon for at least one full day around the summer solstice and below it for at least one day around the winter solstice.

examples.japanese: {北極線|ほっきょくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}えた→越える：02099_koeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{北極線|ほっきょくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This town lies just north of the Arctic Circle.

examples.japanese: {北極線|ほっきょくせん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沈|しず}まない→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: North of the Arctic Circle, there are summer days when the sun never sets.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
English "the Arctic Circle" covers both the line and the region inside it; Japanese splits them. {北極線|ほっきょくせん} is the line, and ⟦{北極圏|ほっきょくけん}→北極圏：23417_hokkyokuken⟧ is the region north of it. In everyday writing ⟦{北極圏|ほっきょくけん}→北極圏：23417_hokkyokuken⟧ is also used loosely for the line (⟦{北極圏|ほっきょくけん}→北極圏：23417_hokkyokuken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧, to cross into the Arctic).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{北極圏|ほっきょくけん}→北極圏：23417_hokkyokuken⟧: the Arctic region
- {南極線|なんきょくせん}: the Antarctic Circle (the line)
- {白夜|びゃくや}: midnight sun, white night
- ⟦{緯線|いせん}→緯線：26195_isen⟧: line of latitude
